_about: Content matrix for faceless 2x2-grid softmaxxing slideshows. Derived from the teardown in docs/slideshow-teardown-clear-food.md. Each post row is a complete slideshow spec; pick rows by id. Tile tokens: plain text = photo of that subject in the post's look; '@person_good' / '@person_bad' = outcome face; '@sprite:<item>' = pixel-art game item icon; '@statue:<pose>' = marble statue photo used as a tile. 'priority' is a heuristic (1 = run first within the bank), not measured data. Formulas marked derived=true are new formats extrapolated from the proven ones and are untested.

question.name: Humble-brag question
question.pattern: Why is my <body part/outcome> so <good adjective>?  (x2)  ->  CTA inside the same grid
question.why_it_works: Reads as a flex, not advice. Viewers comment to ask what the foods do. The same statue on every slide makes it a recognisable series.
description: which one do you do daily?

contrast.name: Average X vs average Y
contrast.why_it_works: Group rivalry gets defensive comments from both sides. The bottom-left face tile turns 'food' into 'what you'll look like'.

mythbust.name: This isn't X / but this is.
mythbust.pattern: <this isn't healthy> (popular 'healthy' or junk foods)  ->  but this is.  ->  CTA
mythbust.seen_in: post E (junk food vs steak, eggs, fruit)
mythbust.why_it_works: Calls out foods people love or think are healthy, so the comments fill with people defending them. The facepalm statue on slide 1 is the punchline.

category.name: real <CATEGORY> list
category.why_it_works: Built to be saved: a cheat-sheet people screenshot. The word 'real' implies everyone else is eating fake versions.
description: screenshot this for your next grocery run

sprite.name: Game-item meme pairing
sprite.pattern: <food> & <food> with real photo + pixel-art item icon on a diagonal  (x3)  ->  CTA
sprite.seen_in: post B (eggs & milk / melon & tomatoes / apples & potatoes)
sprite.why_it_works: Nostalgia hits gamers and stops the scroll. The implied joke ('eat like a block game character') makes it shareable.

routine.name: Routine grid
routine.pattern: softmaxxer <morning/night/sunday> routine: 4 tiles = 4 steps, read left to right (x2)  ->  CTA
routine.seen_in: derived: the category-list visual applied to a daily routine
routine.why_it_works: Creators copy routines, and 'what's your routine' comments bait replies. The moody look signals discipline and is a different look from the food posts.

progress.name: Day-N progress checkpoints
progress.pattern: day 1  ->  day 30  ->  day 90: the grids get cleaner and more disciplined, and the statue tile stays constant  ->  CTA
progress.seen_in: derived: the contrast formula stretched over time, for progress-posting creators
progress.why_it_works: Glow-up arcs are the native story of the niche, and the follow-to-see-day-180 tension gets follows. Faceless, so viewers project themselves onto it.

looks.macro: Extreme close-up overhead photograph of {subject}. The subject completely fills the frame edge to edge, no background visible. Natural soft daylight, rich saturated colour, crisp detail, commercial product photography.
looks.casual: Casual realistic iPhone photo of {subject}, shot in the real-life place it belongs, natural light, slightly imperfect and unstyled, Pinterest aesthetic, shallow depth of field.
looks.moody: Moody dark aesthetic photo of {subject}, low warm light or early-morning blue light, deep shadows, subtle film grain, Pinterest 'discipline' aesthetic, realistic.
looks._suffix: Vertical 2:3 composition, subject centred. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no faces unless asked.

special_tiles.@person_good: Editorial portrait photo of a handsome young man around 20 years old with a sharp defined jawline, clear glowing skin, light eyes and thick dark hair, neutral confident expression looking at the camera, soft beige wall background, natural light, vertical 2:3. No text.
special_tiles.@person_bad: Plain side-profile photo of an ordinary young man around 20 years old with a soft recessed chin, forward head posture and dull tired skin, standing against a plain off-white wall, flat indoor light, unflattering amateur snapshot, vertical 2:3. No text.
special_tiles.@sprite: 16x16 pixel-art inventory item icon of {item} in the style of a blocky voxel survival game, chunky square pixels, simple palette, the icon centred and filling most of the frame on a pure white background, vertical 2:3. No text.
special_tiles.@statue: Black-and-white grey marble classical Greek statue, {pose}, dramatic studio light, plain dark grey background, vertical 2:3. No text.

cutouts.statue_back: Black-and-white grey marble statue of a muscular classical Greek athlete, seen from behind showing a defined back with broken-off arms, head turned to the side in profile with curly hair, dramatic studio light, full bust down to the hips. Isolated on a transparent background, no ground shadow.
cutouts.statue_facepalm: White marble classical statue of a man covering his face with one hand in shame, head and shoulders and upper chest, dramatic soft light. Isolated on a transparent background, no ground shadow.
